description: This Java class implements a LogNode filter that only outputs the message part of logs, removing other metadata such as tags, priorities, or exceptions. It is used in logging frameworks to simplify or customize log output.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter for log output that passes only the message part of logs to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode for chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method that processes log entries; it forwards only the message component to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
